query:
SELECT
                   COALESCE(u.first_name, mr.first_name) AS "first_name?: String",
                   COALESCE(u.last_name, mr.last_name) AS "last_name?: String",
                   u.email AS "email?",
                   mr.note
               FROM manual_rsvps mr
               LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = mr.user_id
               WHERE mr.id = ?
